observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached, placed on a white box with 'McSteve Online Gadget Store' printed on it. The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D90' clearly visible. The lens is labeled 'Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G VR'.

Photo 1 shows the front of the camera from a slightly different angle, with the same lens. The lens barrel has 'Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G VR' visible. The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D90' visible. The screen is off. The camera appears dusty and used.

Photo 2 shows the back of the camera, with the LCD screen turned off. The screen is large and rectangular, typical of Nikon D90 models. The body has 'Nikon' printed below the screen. The camera has visible wear, including scratches and dust on the body and lens barrel.
All photos show the camera on a white box with 'McSteve Online Gadget Store' branding. The background appears to be a store with shelves of electronics and boxes.

claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D90 DSLR Camera With 18-55MM lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the Nikon D90 body and 18-55mm lens. The lens label is clearly visible.
No photo shows the camera powered on or in use. The screen is off in all photos. No proof of functionality is provided.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera powered on, screen lit, and menu navigation.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or focus issues
risks.proof: A video showing the lens focusing and zooming, or a close-up of the lens glass for scratches or fungus.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens may be faulty

risks.risk: Camera may have sensor damage or dust
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the camera's LCD screen with a clear image taken, or a close-up of the sensor area.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor may be damaged

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the battery inserted and charging, or a photo of the charger.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery and charger may be missing

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera powered on and functioning (menu, screen, focus).
Video showing the lens focusing and zooming.
Photo or video of the camera taking a clear photo.
Photo of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
